AboutPage.title: A family business with its hands in the soil for 25 years
AboutPage.intro: Jardí Verd started in Tarragona as a family project built on a simple idea: care for gardens as if they were our own. More than 25 years later, we're still a small, local business, with the experience of having worked on hundreds of gardens and trees across the region.
AboutPage.value1Text: We're from here, and we know the climate, terrain and plant species best suited to every garden in the area.
AboutPage.value2Text: Clear quotes, no surprises. You know exactly what you're paying for and why before we start.
AboutPage.value3Text: Over 25 years in the trade, from the simplest maintenance to the most demanding height pruning.
AboutPage.value4Text: We treat every garden with the same care, whether it's a one-day job or ten years of ongoing maintenance.

Faq.title: What people usually ask us
Faq.subtitle: If your question isn't here, call or message us — we reply quickly.

items.q: Do you offer free, no-obligation quotes?
items.a: Yes, always. We visit your home or plot, assess the job and give you a clear price before starting — no surprises on the invoice.
We work in Tarragona, Reus, Salou, Cambrils, Vila-seca, Altafulla, Torredembarra, Valls, El Vendrell, Constantí and nearby towns. Don't see yours? Ask us anyway.

items.q: Are you equipped for difficult felling and height pruning jobs?
items.a: Yes. We've spent over 25 years doing height pruning with climbing techniques and controlled felling in tight spaces, with the equipment and experience to work safely.

items.q: Can you come urgently if a tree falls or there's storm damage?
items.a: Yes — for urgent cases like trees fallen on roofs, cars or driveways, we aim to respond the same day or the next. Call us directly.

items.q: Do you offer ongoing maintenance, or only one-off jobs?
items.a: Both. We offer weekly, bi-weekly or monthly maintenance contracts, as well as one-off services like cleanups, seasonal tune-ups or specific tree work.
